name: EPIC 220180554
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 7.4 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220180554 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.350295 (16th-84th percentiles 7.041356-7.679188), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220180554: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 5056.404 +/- 88 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220180554 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2880.9375 (16th-84th percentiles 2786.796875-2978.007812), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,881 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.97 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,056 K at its surface.
